data.title: The Pier Residence
data.about:
Nestled in the heart of Dubai Maritime City, The Pier Residence is an exclusive new development by LMD, offering contemporary waterfront living with stunning views and premium lifestyle amenities. Designed for comfort and luxury, the project presents a modern selection of 2 and 3-bedroom apartments crafted with meticulous attention to detail and urban elegance.

The Pier Residence at Maritime City combines prime location with sophisticated architecture and thoughtfully curated features. Residents can enjoy serene sea views along with access to standout facilities such as an infinity pool, rooftop deck, yoga studio, and more. With high investment potential and flexible post-handover payment options, this is a premier address for both homeowners and investors.

characteristics_module.title: The Pier Residence DMC – Waterfront Luxury Living in the Heart of Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Waterfront Living – Enjoy uninterrupted sea views and the serene ambience of coastal living every day.
  • Renowned Developer – The Pier Residence by LMD is backed by a trusted name in real estate innovation.
  • Modern Amenities – State-of-the-art facilities including gym, rooftop pool, yoga studio, and padel court.
  • Attractive Pricing – Starting at just AED 2.8M for luxurious, spacious waterfront apartments in Dubai.
  • High ROI Potential – Benefit from a strategic location and strong rental and resale demand.
  • Post-Handover Payment Plan – Flexible 65/35 payment plan with 2 years post-handover instalments.
  • Thoughtful Floor Plans – Smart layouts for 2 and 3-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living.
  • Family-Friendly Features – Indoor kids’ play area, jogging track, and a welcoming residents’ lounge.

location_tile.title: Waterfront Living with City Access
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Perfectly positioned in Dubai Maritime City, The Pier Residence by LMD offers a seamless blend of tranquillity and connectivity. Residents enjoy being moments away from the coastline while staying well connected to key parts of the city. With direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), commuting to important areas and destinations is quick and effortless.

  • 12 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
